title: Onboarding & Hiring Sync — weekly notes (2026-02-20 to 2026-02-26)
content:
Attendees: Alex Kim (owner), Priya Shah, Marcus Lee, Ruth Alvarez, Daniel Ortega
Meeting date: 2026-02-25 10:00am PT (weekly hiring + onboarding sync)
Purpose: quick status on interviews, onboarding ramps, mentoring capacity, and immediate blockers for new hires joining this quarter. Focus areas: backend/runtime, infra, and SRE handover.

Summary / TL;DR:
- Hiring pipeline remains healthy for Platform Eng: 6 active candidates (3 backend/runtime, 2 infra, 1 SRE). Two offers extended this week (candidate A - backend, candidate B - infra).
- Onboarding: 3 new hires started in last 2 weeks; onboarding checklist mostly green but one blocker (access to GPU test cluster) persists.
- Interview debriefs flagged an alignment gap on our runtime design exercise; need a short calibration doc for interviewers.
- Team health: bandwidth tight for mentorship due to Q1 priorities; propose reducing interview load for core mentors for next 2 weeks.

Hiring pipeline details:
- Candidates (short notes):
  - Candidate A (Backend/runtime) - offer extended, verbal accepted, HR to send formal offer Monday 2/28. Strong on attention optimizations, needs ramp on our compilation stack. Interview panel: Priya, Marcus, Emily.
  - Candidate B (Infra) - offer extended, ask for slight salary negotiation; TBD. Good infra/tooling background, large-scale GPU ops experience.
  - Candidate C (Runtime) - onsite loop done, mixed signals on team fit; follow-up debrief scheduled 2/26.
  - Candidate D (SRE) - strong on reliability and chaos engineering, asked for remote-first flexibility.
  - Candidate E (Backend) - take-home assignment pending review (due 2/28).
  - Candidate F (Infra) - initial screen passed, scheduling interview with Marcus.
- Action: Priya to consolidate compensation bands and prepare negotiation guidance by 2/27 (JIRA-ENG-8721).

Interview calibration / debriefs:
- Pattern: multiple interviewers noted candidates do well on algorithmic puzzles but struggle with our system-design prompt that focuses on streaming KV cache and continuous batching.
- Root cause hypothesis: the exercise is currently too open-ended, inconsistent across interviewers.
- Quick fix: create a 1-pager interviewer playbook with expected candidate signals (marshalling prior work on batching, clear tradeoffs, latency vs cost reasoning).
- Owner: Marcus to draft playbook by 3/03. Priya will collect sample answers from top candidates to include.

Onboarding status (new hires):
- New hires: Ana (Platform infra eng) started 2026-02-10, Jonah (Runtime eng) started 2026-02-17, Mei (SRE) started 2026-02-12.
- Checklist items completed: laptop issued, security training done, basic repo access granted, intro rotations scheduled.
- Blocker: GPU test cluster credentials and namespace allocation delayed due to cloud quota process. Impact: Ana and Jonah cannot run end-to-end perf tests yet.
- Action: Ruth to escalate cloud quota ticket (CONF-PLATFORM-ONBOARD-001) and get GPU namespace allocated by 2/28.
- Mentorship: mentor pairs assigned but mentors report limited time; suggest reducing meeting cadence to weekly 30m for next 4 weeks.

Ramp metrics & expectations:
- Proposed 30/60/90 goals for Runtime hires (draft):
  - 30d: local dev workflow, run small models end-to-end, land first small PR (infra or perf test).
  - 60d: own a small feature (batching config change), run perf benchmark, present learnings in team sync.
  - 90d: own a rollout for a non-critical model variant and write postmortem template.
- Action: Alex to share 30/60/90 templated doc in onboarding folder by 2/28.

Team health & bandwidth:
- Observations: mentors and ICs are at ~85% sprint capacity; several large infra tasks in flight (autoscaling improvements, KMS integration for Private deploys).
- Risk: if we continue full interviewer load, hiring cycle will slow and onboarding experience will degrade.
- Proposal: temporarily reassign interviewing to a broader panel (include developer experience and solutions engineers) to reduce load on core mentors.
- Action: Daniel to coordinate updated interviewer roster and run a skip-level interview training session on 3/05.

Open issues / blockers:
- GPU namespace allocation for new hires (see above).
- Onboarding docs outdated: compilation/kernels README missing recent kernel-selection flow. Owner: Priya to update README by 3/06.
- Compensation mismatch on candidate B negotiation; Damon from People Ops to support closing.

Decisions made:
- Extend offers to A and B (A accepted verbally).
- Create an interviewer playbook and standardize the runtime system-design prompt.
- Reduce mentor interview load for two weeks; broaden interviewing pool.

Action items (owners + due dates):
- Priya: compensation guidance & update compilation README (due 3/06).
- Marcus: interviewer playbook draft (due 3/03).
- Ruth: escalate cloud quota & GPU namespace allocation (due 2/28).
- Daniel: update interviewer roster + training session (due 3/05).
- Alex: 30/60/90 ramp templates in onboarding folder (due 2/28).
- People Ops (Damon): assist with candidate B negotiation (ongoing).

Notes to self / next steps for next week's sync:
- Check GPU access resolution and try to get at least one smoke perf run from Jonah.
- Review candidate C debrief and finalize decision.
- Track onboarding satisfaction with a 2-week pulse survey for new hires (Ruth to draft).

Meeting adjourned 10:45am PT. Next sync: 2026-03-03 10:00am PT (weekly).

Rough/raw items / scratch (keep here for convos):
- Consider a hiring freeze for one week when critical rollout hits if capacity gets worse.
- Might rotate pair-mentors to avoid single point of failure when mentor is on leave.
- Quick win: add a small checklist item for GPU quota in the offer/first-day checklist to surface early.

End of notes.
